Dear Friends,
I’m not ready to give up on the future of our region and I’m writing to you because I know you feel the same way. Washington and Harrisburg are both messes, and the liberal policies that we see coming out of Harrisburg are troubling, to say the least.
When the supposed “Red Wave'' of 2022 turned into a Blue Lagoon, we learned just how power hungry the hard-left Democrats have become. Now, they are coming for former Speaker Mike Turzai’s old seat, the seat currently held by State Representative Rob Mercuri, who has decided not to seek re-election to the State House in order to run for Congress. I’m determined to make sure we hold this seat and continue commonsense leadership in Pennsylvania’s 28th district.
It’s why I’m running for State Representative and it’s why I’m asking, once again, for your help. We absolutely must keep the 28th District in the Republican column. Otherwise, we risk handing it over to a liberal Democrat who is already trying to hide his liberalism. We’ve seen that tactic before. Let’s not fall for it.
Well, I’m not about to hide my commonsense conservatism. I’m proud of my success in business. I’m proud of my service in local government and the community. I’m proud to be a husband and father of my five children. I make no apologies for my faith and I don’t just share the values of this district – I admire them. And I know that it’s going to be a tough fight. The 28th District is one of the few remaining Republican Districts in Allegheny County. We’ll be facing a million-dollar ad blitz by Harrisburg Democrats determined to keep the State House in Democrat hands providing a rubber-stamp for a liberal governor. They’re ready to spend big to spread personal attacks. I’m ready to fight back. But I can’t fight alone. I need good, commonsense conservatives like you to have my back.
In 2022, I outperformed the top of the ticket by 20 percentage points, and handily won in the 28th District in our run for Congress. With all the odds against us, I was still able to prove that voters in this District need and want a conservative voice who prioritizes the things they value: good schools, safe streets, and an affordable, good quality of life. That’s what I will always fight for.
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=5f3ac0fff5&e=8c80cba7e7)
Once again, I’m asking for your help. No one will work harder, knock more doors, and speak up for our District more than I will. Please join with me and invest in our future by partnering with me in this campaign.
Sincerely,
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=8a4b468fa0&e=8c80cba7e7)

**In some areas, parents have only two options:**

_March 18, 2024 - Brea, CA_
The results are still coming in, but it's clear that the outcome of this election is not what we hoped for.1
We got into this race with clarity that voters were looking for something different than what's on offer in American politics today. **A focus on economics -- not identity. A passion for country -- not party. A commitment to Service Over Politics.**
My involvement in politics endures, and this only deepens my commitment to service. Since I came to this country at 9 years old, my family has been fortunate to live the American Dream. We have so much work to do until it's real for every family in OC.
**I am so proud of the race we ran. The first of many. And a strong beginning.**
A few things we accomplished this cycle:
* **[Voter Voices](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d83c08d9-d7e4-4c4f-b6cf-907a4ec3d583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) :** an innovative YouTube pilot centering the concerns of local residents -- not the circus in DC -- wherein I listen more than I talk.

* **[#WTFCongress](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bad1c93b-bfb6-4520-8df4-924d7122b18d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) :** an IG/TikTok/LinkedIn spotlight on what's broken in Washington + how to fix it. Relatedly, [the most aggressive anti-corruption plan](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/17a0f3e7-9df8-4429-a179-0d9e2488eec6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of any congressional challenger in '24, echoed by ongoing proposals in Congress.
* **[Chai with Pai](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e67a3c9d-91c4-4cfd-a0da-98703b54c628?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** : warm, intimate, interactive town halls across CA-45.

* **['Finding Joy'](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8e0cafb9-6e45-412b-b3dd-d436c355be93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**: a unique documentary about the political process that we'll likely disseminate more widely soon. The first ever by a federal candidate released _before_ an election. Several voters told me it informed their vote for the better.
* Most important, **[testimonials](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6654e65b-fc9c-43a5-bab2-c5fcc58d47fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from local residents we've helped with legal cases, pro bono, and the trust of voters who believe in our brand of direct service.

Double-click the links above to watch what you can. It made a difference.
To our donors, supporters, volunteers, team members, mentors, and the 7,000+ voters who marked my name on a ballot, with faith in my leadership:
**Thank You.**
It has been the honor of a lifetime to run this race for you.
The journey continues 🇺🇸
_-pai_

body:

| | |
---

---
|
Hello, I hope that your weekend was great! Spring is springing.

As most of you know, I supported Dean Phillips in his presidential run that recently ended. I was glad to support Dean – he is the kind of pragmatic, well-intended, bipartisan 55-year old leader that most Americans actually want.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=a65d6ce7e4&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Dean got 20% of the primary vote in New Hampshire, and it would have been much higher if Independents had participated in the Democratic Primary. That 20% was based on about 10 weeks of campaigning in the state and expenditures of about $6 million. There were enough television commercials in New Hampshire where a majority of voters knew who he was.

This was not the case in South Carolina or nationally. In order to succeed, Dean would need to spend $10 – 12 million in the next contested state, Michigan, to build the same kind of name ID as quickly as possible. Focus groups showed that Dean’s ceiling was quite high in Michigan; over 50% of focus group participants said they’d vote for him. That money never came, and his support plummeted down to the low single-digits. Dean dropped out after Super Tuesday and endorsed Joe Biden, a decision I agree with, as his campaign was past a point where it would have been good for the country. And Dean’s interest has always been to do what he thought was right for the country.

Now the focus turns to primaries around the country and of course the November presidential election. There are candidates around the country that I’m excited about. One is Andy Kim, who is running for U.S. Senator in New Jersey against the corrupt Bob Menendez and the first lady of the state, Tammy Murphy. I’ve known Andy for years and he’s an earnest public servant who is as upright as it gets. Watching the Democratic establishment close ranks against Andy – despite the fact that he’s a sitting member of Congress in excellent standing – has been educational.

I’m also excited about John Avlon, who is running for Congress in Long Island. John is a political reformer at heart who is stepping up to run because he thinks he can make New York’s 1st district competitive. John is an author and journalist who is as patriotic as it gets. He’ll be for reforms like Ranked Choice Voting and would be a prominent voice in Congress for transcending partisanship.

This week on the podcast I interview Krist Novoselic, co-founder of the rockband Nirvana and chair of the Washington Forward Party. Krist and Forward are backing positive local candidates around the country. Krist used to be the chair of the local Democratic Party but became an enormous champion of independent politics years ago as the chair of Fairvote. I was in high school when “Smells Like Teen Spirit” hit the airwaves, so it’s a lot of fun working with a bonafide rockstar like Krist to help make good things happen. “We need something different in our politics, I’ve known that for years.”

Indeed, I think that’s one of the joys of Forward – you can get behind any candidate of any party if you think they will help make good things possible.

Dean Phillips was one such candidate. If I had the chance to do it all over again, I’d be glad to.

To everyone who leant Dean a hand or gave him a look, Thank you!

Click here to check out Andy Kim, John Avlon, and your local Forward chapter. For my convo with Krist click here. Let’s get behind good people who want to make good things happen for families and communities.

---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

Krist and Forward are backing positive local candidates around the country. Krist used to be the chair of the local Democratic Party but became an enormous champion of independent politics years ago as the chair of Fairvote. I was in high school when “Smells Like Teen Spirit” hit the airwaves, so it’s a lot of fun working with a bonafide rockstar like Krist to help make good things happen. “We need something different in our politics, I’ve known that for years.” Indeed, I think that’s one of the joys of Forward – you can get behind any candidate of any party if you think they will help make good things possible. Dean Phillips was one such candidate. If I had the chance to do it all over again, I’d be glad to. To everyone who leant Dean a hand or gave him a look, Thank you! Click here to check out Andy Kim, John Avlon, and your local Forward chapter. For my convo with Krist click here. Let’s get behind good people who want to make good things happen for families and communities. | Andrew Yang Co-Chair, Forward Party | | | Want to change how you receive these emails? You can or .

I can’t wait to get to Washington, D.C. to bring the conservative change we need: close the border, bring down spending and the cost of living, put dangerous criminals behind bars, where they belong, and promote education freedom and choice.” Evans will also compete in the CD 8 Republican assembly on March 30. | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: Monday, March 18, 2024
STATEMENT FROM SENATE REPUBLICAN LEADER ROB ORTT AND ASSEMBLY REPUBLICAN LEADER WILL BARCLAY
The Minority Leaders of the New York State Legislature, Sen. Rob Ortt and Assemblyman Will Barclay, with the support of Senate and Assembly Republicans, today issued the following endorsement of Donald J. Trump:
"Donald Trump is the clear choice - the only choice - to lead America for the next four years and has our endorsement for President of the United States. More than ever, our country needs a Commander in Chief who is fully qualified and committed to the success, sovereignty and security of our great nation. President Trump achieved that in his first term and will once again deliver for the American people.
Joe Biden's tenure in office has been a disaster both home and abroad. He has overseen the country's worst inflation in 40 years, stood idle as 9 million illegal immigrants flooded across our borders, allowed foreign conflicts to play out on multiple fronts, and orchestrated a withdrawal from Afghanistan that left 13 Americans dead. Joe Biden's job-approval rating is among the worst in history for a reason - he's earned it.
President Trump provides the strong, capable, common-sense leadership to restore American greatness now and well into the future."

**Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand introduces a resolution to certify the Equal Rights Amendment and enshrine reproductive rights in the Constitution.**
Friend, the Equal Rights Amendment (ERA) would establish that our civil rights cannot be infringed upon or taken away on the basis of gender. Activists have been fighting for nearly 100 years to add this amendment to our Constitution — and we can't wait any longer.

Right now, we're closer than ever before to certifying the ERA: 38 states have ratified it, and it's just one signature away from being added to the Constitution. _But an arbitrary deadline is stopping us from finally certifying this amendment!_
**That's why Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand has introduced new legislation that would establish that this deadline should _not_ stop us from certifying the ERA. **With bipartisan support and filibuster reform, we can pass this legislation, finally establish gender equality in our Constitution and restore reproductive freedoms nationwide.

Right now, we're closer than ever before to certifying the ERA: 38 states have ratified it, and it's just one signature away from being added to the Constitution. But an arbitrary deadline is stopping us from finally certifying this amendment! That's why Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand has introduced new legislation that would establish that this deadline should not stop us from certifying the ERA. With bipartisan support and filibuster reform, we can pass this legislation, finally establish gender equality in our Constitution and restore reproductive freedoms nationwide. This is a crucial moment in our fight for gender equality and reproductive rights. Kirsten needs to know where grassroots activists like you stand on the ERA. | | | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 – and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbnu7h0g1vgp4ta354bbq3jmtsjrhhomjheu6v18_rp22sh2s8i6ep30ctge1ob2cph2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College’s **[National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z21ps43q65p4eciou0p9qcoav09t4k612lnt0ui0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30ctge1ob2cph2bs).** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration’s weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the[Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z080lvpivh7j3budtbehoqv9e7fs0sqjrqvvqit0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30ctge1ob2cph2bs).** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6bgvfibju05i35vprucr3dp3upnp76758qrh8ko_rp22sh2s8i6ep30ctge1ob2cph2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today’s ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we’ve seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our [**National Survey on the Department of Justice**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmg75ir6tdibpet14hsc83g29m5u6g8s9jddqeko_rp22sh2s8i6ep30ctge1ob2cph2bs) and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zidtle19kubf90fc2fm06o2nua7ahkl953ci1gsg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30ctge1ob2cph2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

subject: Good news and bad news:
body:
If you haven’t seen the news yet...

| | |

| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbe71cb5f-834e-420b-9d28-fdda3034a43c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

---
| | | | | Peter, If you haven’t seen the news yet, Kyrsten Sinema isn’t running for re-election in Arizona. Arizona’s Senate campaign is going to be a head-to-head between Ruben Gallego and Kari Lake. And we’ve got some good news, and some bad news. **The good news** is that we’ve built an incredible campaign so far. We’ve got close to 150,000 individual donors, and we’ve raised enough to be really competitive this year. **The bad news** is that this campaign is about to get a lot more complicated — and expensive. We’re expecting millions of dollars in attack ads to start coming our way any day now. More than $230 million was spent in Arizona’s Senate campaign in 2022, and we expect this one to be just as expensive. **What that means is that we need a huge surge of donations from folks who have been on the sidelines so far to stay competitive. We need you to make a donation today.** Our average contribution is about $24. Some give more, many give less. Today, the most important thing is that you make that donation. [**Can Ruben Gallego count on you to chip in and split your donation between Blue Amp Action and his campaign? In a race this important every single donation matters, no matter the amount. They add up fast when everyone’s chipping in.** ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T72966bad-3f6d-4326-8453-ee8240ec629e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

— RECENT MISSOURI SENATE POLLING —
**Kunce 43% | Hawley 44% | +/-3% Margin Of Error

When I was at the Pentagon doing arms control, I saw our embarrassing and dangerous inability to build what we needed, including subs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a017e82c-c51f-4dac-8cb9-bdc2a06a5d78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/531849b2-a52f-421e-9cd4-d844df1cd92f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_See_ : [https://twitter.com/SaraLSirota/status/1767284987026370966](https://substack.com/redirect/113324e0-9acc-455a-8f92-6880525134e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Like 2⁄3 of our military contracts, most of the Columbia class sub-production is sole-sourced. No competition. No alternative contractor if the supplier fails.
We are in this position because our politicians let our entire defense industry consolidate into a few goliaths who now run the show. These monopolists name their price, they name their timeline, and they change both at will because even the Pentagon has no leverage against their monopoly positions. We ran into the same thing when I was on the Joint Staff doing arms control and we were looking to buy new aircraft for the then Open Skies Treaty.
This didn't just happen. It was by design. We put financiers in charge of everything and this is their end state. Grifting off monopoly rents and the taxpayer - warfighter and national security be damned. I was so frustrated by it at the Pentagon that I wrote about this transformation of our production and innovation capacity in the American Conservative while I was still on active duty.
_**America 's Monopoly Crisis Hits the Military: [theamericanconservative.com/americas-monopoly-crisis-hits-the-military/](https://substack.com/redirect/b22e2b2b-136f-41af-88e8-def99703895f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **_
Finance-driven CEOs of massive companies control much of our national security decisions. And these are some of the least patriotic and most anti-worker people in the country! You don't have to take my word for it. Former Exxon CEO Lee Raymond summarized their attitude best: "I'm not a U.S. company and I don't make decisions based on what's good for the U.S."
We can't even make anything anymore. When we were at the Pentagon, we found we couldn't make a single major weapon system without inputs from China. Because the CEOs had offshored it all.
_Lockheed Martin to its Workers:**" We are actively looking for ways to outsource your job."**_
_**New Inkstick datasets detail anti-labor trends at top Pentagon contractors:[inkstickmedia.com/union-strength-dwindles-at-top-defense-contractors/](https://substack.com/redirect/02d9bacf-65ee-45be-8f54-c1d1d89fbf97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
_**US military too reliant on foreign-made equipment:**_**[pcworld.com/article/451743/study-us-military-too-reliant-on-foreignmade-equipment.html](https://substack.com/redirect/a1eb5259-2363-4088-9e9b-1adee2df32ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **
This thinking has even corrupted the way our country thinks about how we defend ourselves and what's actually important to defend. Just look at our recent airstrikes in the Middle East. We've been spending huge sums of tax dollars and putting American soldiers and seamen in harm's way for years. What's it gotten us?
Nothing in Afghanistan. "Regional stability" for dictators who'd turn on us at a moment's notice if it was convenient, secure trade routes for foreign adversaries and multinational outsourcers, and an excuse for the military to use up equipment and resources that can then be wastefully (but profitably) replaced by only a handful of defense contractors who are also doing everything in their power to prevent American workers from getting their hands on any of the money.
_**Defense Contractors Benefited From Nearly Half of $14 Trillion Spent for Afghan War:[newsweek.com/defense-contractors-benefited-nearly-half-14-trillion-spent-afghan-war-study-1628485](https://substack.com/redirect/6075fe1f-219e-4a3d-b9b4-109439bc181d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **_
The financiers who run these giants use their monopoly position to extract wealth from all of us and transfer it to their shareholders. They use their monopoly position to convert national security risk to all of us into profit for their shareholders. It's not capitalism, it's just another cartel. And until we meet strength with strength, they will continue to rob us.
We have to break up Big Defense and on-shore our defense supply chains.
Unfortunately, the members of Congress who oversee the defense industry aren't just bought off by campaign donations, they are bought into the scheme. Politicians from both parties have stock portfolios flush with stock in these companies.
That's why we need to abolish corporate PACs (and ACTUALLY overturn Citizens United) and criminalize stock ownership for members of Congress.
And just like Missouri's own Harry Truman understood when he was just a U.S. Senator during World War II, we also need to safeguard American taxpayers from the government and corporate corruption taking place in our defense industry.
_**Harry Truman and the Investigation of Waste, Fraud, & Abuse in World War II: [levin-center.org/harry-truman-and-the-investigation-of-waste-fraud-abuse-in-world-war-ii/](https://substack.com/redirect/3bc096ca-7c0b-4b99-8599-1032eb897c9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
That will take tough action from Congress, the DoJ, the FTC, and more -- and it will take REQUIRING action to truly happen.
So in the U.S. Senate, I'll introduce comprehensive and robust legislation to bar defense contractors from electoral politics, ban former DoD officials from lobbying on behalf of the defense industry, and formally outlaw war profiteering. And I'll include the tools enforcers will need to enforce the rules and require regular Congressional oversight to make sure that enforcement becomes a reality.
It's time to make our national security the focus of America's defense industry -- not corporate profits.

## The ONLY Thing That Actually Matters
---

Today, I really want to reach out to you, Peter.
**When Scott Wallace and I founded this organization, we set out to empower the next generation of PA Democrat leaders to serve the common good.** We knew this was no small task, but we were up to the challenge because our democracy rests on all of us getting involved and doing our part to preserve it.
With the 2024 election underway, Pennsylvania voters will have the opportunity to shape the future of our country as a must-win swing state. We’ve already seen so much progress at the state level where Democrats retained control of the state House majority in multiple elections.
But we’re up against a well-funded group of extremists doing everything they can to roll back progress. And we cannot take anything for granted between now and November.
[I’m asking you directly to help invest in the future of our party. subject: This week in Texas - March 18

body:
[1]Powered By People

Here’s what Powered by People is working on this week:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Supporting Texas wildfire victims

In some great news for Texas, firefighters have completely contained the
Smokehouse Creek Fire that burned over a million acres in the Texas
Panhandle over the last three weeks.

Thanks to all who have donated to support those who lost their homes and
livestock. If you haven’t yet, please consider making a contribution to
help those who are still working to get back on their feet:

* Connect Community Services is providing food, hygiene items, clothing,
and housing support to those most in need. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62835?t=1001&akid=239523%2E444211%2E8dqDCz ]Donate here.

* The Texas Farm Bureau’s Texas Panhandle Wildfire Relief Fund is
helping farmers and ranchers with unreimbursed agriculture losses.
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62836?t=1002&akid=239523%2E444211%2E8dqDCz ]Donate here.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Reaching the millions of new Texas voters

New census data shows that Texas holds eight of the fastest growing
counties in the country. We also continue to have the second-largest
number and percentage of young people in the nation.

This news makes all the more clear why we must reach, register, and turn
out the Texas voters who have either recently moved here or become newly
eligible to vote.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62176?source=ema20240318-239523&t=1003&akid=239523%2E444211%2E8dqDCz ]If you live in Texas, that means signing up to help us reach the
millions of unregistered voters in this state. Join us for a 45-minute
Volunteer Deputy Registrar training with us over Zoom, and then we’ll put
you to work.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62176?source=ema20240318-239523&t=1004&akid=239523%2E444211%2E8dqDCz ]SIGN UP

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240318.jxfQq8&refcode=ema20240318-239523&t=1005&akid=239523%2E444211%2E8dqDCz ]Otherwise, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution today. Your
support will ensure we have the resources to recruit the volunteers we
need to register and organize new Democratic voters in Texas.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240318.jxfQq8&refcode=ema20240318-239523&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=239523%2E444211%2E8dqDCz ]CONTRIBUTE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

What else we’re watching...

* Texas abortion ban: Texas’ total abortion ban continues to force women
to continue dangerous, nonviable pregnancies that could kill them. As
Texas medical providers beg for guidance on when they can terminate a
pregnancy to save a woman’s life, the Texas Medical Board has agreed
to begin a [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63037?t=1025&akid=239523%2E444211%2E8dqDCz ]30-day rule-making process this week to craft this
guidance.

* Texas Senate Bill 4: The U.S. Supreme Court is [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63038?t=1026&akid=239523%2E444211%2E8dqDCz ]expected to make a
decision today on Texas Senate Bill 4, an unconstitutional bill that
will clearly lead to racial profiling by allowing police to arrest
anyone — including U.S. citizens — just for looking like an immigrant.
The decision will have major implications for the rights of immigrants
and Latino Americans across the country.

* DHS funding in Congress: As Texas Republicans try to interfere with
immigration law, their counterparts in Congress are trying to block
$1.56 billion for the Department of Homeland Security’s border
security efforts. Congress has until this Friday, March 22, to come to
an agreement on the funding before forcing [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63039?t=1027&akid=239523%2E444211%2E8dqDCz ]yet another government
shutdown.

A lot going on, a lot to work on. Thank you for supporting our efforts to
register and turn out the voters who can be the difference in critical
upcoming elections.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

I hope it’s a great week for you.

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1028&akid=239523%2E444211%2E8dqDCz

body:
And he’s a former Wall Street investment banker.
#
When it comes to campaigning, our motto has always been to focus on our record, and not give opponents any free publicity. But it's official:
Just before the deadline, a former investment banker that lives in a multi-million dollar home outside of Alexandria’s district has launched his campaign to unseat her.
Alexandria’s primary is in 3 months. We need to be ready to fight back against our new opponent’s mailers, commercials, and whatever else he’ll throw at us.
**We need your help to prepare for those attacks.**
[Will you donate $5 right now to help us defeat this Wall Street millionaire calling Alexandria ‘radical’ for wanting Medicare for All? Every dollar goes to keeping Alexandria in Congress fighting for a better future for all.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240318-1.xWys2M&refcode=em20240318-6018-P_FND_RES_HDL&t=1&akid=6018%2E2526796%2EbCtu-N)

Alexandria’s opponent popped up only this week because of New York’s congressional redistricting process. He had previously filed paperwork to challenge Jamaal Bowman in the Democratic primary — **but after the redistricting process was finalized, he switched to target Alexandria instead**.
Our challenger may entirely self-fund his campaign — or simply reach out for support from AIPAC or any of the special interests pouring hundreds of millions into this election to unseat the Squad and Alexandria.
Many progressives have been defeated over these last few years because they were heavily outspent. We can’t let that happen to Alexandria.
Alexandria doesn’t host fancy cocktail fundraisers asking wealthy donors for big checks — she relies only on our grassroots movement.

body:
Following the IVF decision in Alabama, it has become more apparent than ever that we need representatives who will defend our reproductive rights | | | | |

---
In the wake of the recent IVF decision in Alabama, it has become more apparent than ever that **we need representatives who will fiercely defend our reproductive rights.** Joseph Alfonso is dedicated to championing these rights and ensuring that every individual has the autonomy to make decisions about their own bodies.
**The Importance of Protecting Reproductive Rights** Access to family planning resources, including In Vitro Fertilization (IVF), should never be subject to political whims. There are millions of every-day people, including veterans who suffered injuries from wars, who use this procedure to build their families. Joseph will advocate for policies that empower individuals and families, ensuring they have **the freedom to make the choices that align with their values and aspirations.**
**Family Planning for a Stronger Future** Our families are the backbone of our communities. We should envision a future where families can thrive, supported by **policies that encourage comprehensive family planning options and access to vital reproductive healthcare services.** By supporting Team Alfonso, you are endorsing a candidate committed to building a future where everyone can pursue their dreams and shape their family life according to their wishes.
**Support Alfonso, Support Reproductive Rights** Your vote is not just a political statement; it's a powerful choice to protect our reproductive rights and ensure that every family has the freedom to plan their future.

You can sign your name in support of a Prescription Drug Affordability Board, and we’ll send it to the Governor.

**Republicans in Tennessee and across the country are waging war on women’s reproductive rights.** _First, they focused on state-level abortion bans._ _Then, radicals like Marsha Blackburn supported banning abortion at the national level._ **And we know that contraception access is in the GOP’s sights, too.** **Marsha even called the Supreme Court decision granting the right to birth control “constitutionally unsound.”** My colleague TN state Senator Charlane Oliver and I recently wrote an Op-Ed for _The Tennessean_ on our bill to protect contraception access in Tennessee. I want to share some of the most important parts with you, then, **_[I need to ask you to contribute to my campaign](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81190155/461664560/-1218973835?refcode=ea.0043a991-40e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ms=ea.0043a991-40e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDQzYTk5MS00MGU1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=chc8tdi-6squa-_DoBFc5zkAsP7HCqPwAy46qC5OZ1s=)_** for the U.S. Senate, so I can get to work for you in Washington. | [**DONATE**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81190156/461664561/-1218973835?refcode=ea.0043a991-40e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ms=ea.0043a991-40e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDQzYTk5MS00MGU1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=chc8tdi-6squa-_DoBFc5zkAsP7HCqPwAy46qC5OZ1s=)

* * *
**Tennessee must protect the rights and freedom of women to access contraception**
In Tennessee, living under the nation's most extreme abortion ban, it's become clear that protecting the right to contraception is essential.
Introducing the Tennessee Contraceptive Freedom Act (Senate Bill 1804/House Bill 1943) is our commitment to ensuring every Tennessean can make decisions about starting a family on their terms, without government interference.
The battle to protect reproductive freedom in Tennessee is intensifying.
The Tennessee Contraceptive Freedom Act is not just a legislative action; it’s a strong declaration of our commitment to personal freedoms and the well-being of all Tennesseans. This act serves as a beacon of hope amidst the wave of dangerous restrictions that threaten our right to make informed decisions about our reproductive health.

subject: What happens on 3/31

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=2367%2E552475%2EuW4C9i)
Peter, it’s Tiernan, Bob’s Campaign Manager. We’re coming up on a major moment in our campaign, so I had to reach out.
**Midnight on March 31st — just two weeks away — is the very first Federal Election Commission deadline of 2024.**
This is a longer message explaining what exactly that means for our campaign, but if you’re ready to donate right away, you can at this link.
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240318-1?refcode=20240318-1**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240318-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240318-1&refcode2=2367_552475_uW4C9i&akid=2367%2E552475%2EuW4C9i)
The FEC deadline is not arbitrary, Peter. After that, we’re required to publicly report everything we’ve raised in the last three months. Since we’re running to re-elect Bob in a state that’s a top target of the national GOP, and since we were outraised last quarter, all eyes will be on our campaign to see how much we’re able to raise.
When we file our report, it will show support from veterans, teachers, small business owners, health care workers, and more. It will show how we’re building a hard-working team that has Bob’s back as we fight to keep our Commonwealth from flipping red.
As for our opponent? David McCormick has been busy these past few months cozying up to out-of-state Wall Street billionaires and fake electors. It’s clear that he’s out for himself, while Bob focuses on helping working families across Pennsylvania.
Look, this race is personal for all of us — but it’s also the toughest election of Bob’s career. A new poll shows our lead is slipping, and we could face hundreds of millions of dollars spent to defeat Bob and take away our Democratic Senate and White House. **That’s what’s at stake with every deadline we face.**
[**Peter, your support is how we’re able to run this campaign. Please chip in $5 or whatever you can to help us win this battleground race and keep Bob in the Senate fighting for PA.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240318-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240318-1&refcode2=2367_552475_uW4C9i&akid=2367%2E552475%2EuW4C9i)

Let’s break down the former president’s rap sheet of attacks on Black America. Donald Trump:
❌ Shamelessly attacked voting rights and protections for Black Americans, seeking to suppress our voices;
❌ Wants to rip insurance coverage from over 3 million Black Americans and raise costs for millions of Black families;
❌ Called for punishing women who have an abortion, disregarding reproductive autonomy and further undermining decades of progress in reproductive healthcare access; and
❌ Pushed for more guns on our streets and in our schools, ignoring the devastating toll of gun violence on our communities and advocating for policies that put our lives in even greater danger.
Peter — this is just a snapshot of Trump’s destructive agenda, one marked by racism, division, and a blatant disregard for the well-being of our communities.

_**We can’t afford to ignore the looming threat of his potential re-election.**_

[Will you rush a donation of $10 or whatever you can to help us defend ourselves from Trump’s racist agenda? | | In this latest newsletter below, Dom categorically addresses a critical environmental issue that affects our community. She discusses the new oil sheen found in Huntington Beach and outlines her plan for combatting such hazards. Make sure to read Dom's memorandum to stay informed and learn about the actions she is suggesting we take in coastal Orange County to protect our environment.

| | MEMORANDUMTO: All Concerned Of Coastal Orange CountySeal Beach, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Laguna BeachFROM: Dom Jones, Candidate for State Assembly AD72DATE: March 8, 2024 SUBJECT: Proactive Measures in Response to Huntington Beach Oil Sheen Incident I am writing to address a matter of immediate concern that affects our community – the recently reported 2.5-mile-long oil sheen, 1.5 miles off the coast of Huntington Beach, yet again. In less than 2 years our precious coastline has become hit once again by the awful crude oil platforms that are digging in our beautiful ocean that serves as a community Pool for all families to enjoy in magnificent coastal Orange County.-Do we want to invite our friends to enjoy a day at the beach and bring our children to swim in oil? This hurts our tourist economy, our lifestyles, and our home values drastically. This MUST end.-This incident highlights the urgent need for comprehensive action to protect our environment and the well-being of our residents. Background:As many of you are aware, the 1970s oil derricks and offshore platforms in the Huntington Beach area have been a source of ongoing environmental degradation. The recent oil sheen incident underscores the pressing need to reassess our reliance on these outdated structures and transition towards cleaner, more sustainable alternatives. Immediate Action Steps:In response to the Huntington Beach oil sheen incident, I am proposing the following immediate action steps: 1\. Shutdown of 1970s Oil Derricks: I am a proponent of initiating a comprehensive plan to safely shut down and decommission the aging and highly dangerous oil derricks that pose a heightened risk to our coastal environment, health of our sea life and the health of our families and children. With of course careful consideration as to how this can be done to protect our most vulnerable environmental frontiers in our region. 2\. Phased Decommissioning of Offshore Platforms: I encourage us to develop a phased approach to decommission offshore platforms, taking into account environmental impact assessments, laborer livelihood, economic considerations, and the safety of our coastal communities. 3\. Transition to Renewable Energy: I will advocate for policies and incentives to accelerate the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy sources, fostering a more sustainable and environmentally friendly energy landscape. 4\. Strengthened Regulatory Oversight: Collaborate with regulatory bodies to enhance monitoring and enforcement mechanisms, ensuring strict adherence to environmental standards within the offshore drilling industry. We want to ensure that there is firm adherence to protection of our oceans. Community Engagement:I am committed to fostering open dialogue and collaboration with our community throughout this process. Your input, concerns, and ideas are invaluable as we work together to address this critical issue. Stay Informed:For a detailed overview of these proposed measures and our ongoing efforts, please stay attuned to my comprehensive and feasible plan, via the next memorandum update. This will help protect our coastal communities and bring economic prosperity while doing so.It is essential that we stay informed and engaged in the collective endeavor to protect our environment and build a sustainable future for Orange County. Your support in these crucial initiatives is vital, and I deeply encourage you to share your thoughts and feedback as we move forward. You can reach me through my team at contact@domjones.orgThank you for your dedication to the well-being of our community. Sincerely,Dom JonesYour Future State Assemblywoman on November 8th, 2024Candidate for State Assembly

Strengthened Regulatory Oversight: Collaborate with regulatory bodies to enhance monitoring and enforcement mechanisms, ensuring strict adherence to environmental standards within the offshore drilling industry. We want to ensure that there is firm adherence to protection of our oceans. Community Engagement:I am committed to fostering open dialogue and collaboration with our community throughout this process. Your input, concerns, and ideas are invaluable as we work together to address this critical issue. name: Trump Train News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ze8m3ncuv45vd7hfvqkdetm4shr1lfhca9ihv9ng_rp22sh2s8i6ep30ctie2pr6c5h2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. You can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7n5ij2ml4rv836cfup858vnnrgq2n0gc83o6mco_rp22sh2s8i6ep30ctie2pr6c5h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education** , including **a required course on the Constitution**
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zro85p6bv8bjpikvagiavhlrj0f7frv0bklh6358_rp22sh2s8i6ep30ctie2pr6c5h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 P.S. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, **I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today**. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice, which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9hltafpcgmfnh08hbrltvbsu61u9cbavubr2tpo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30ctie2pr6c5h2bs)** |

❌ 14 congresswomen (11 Democrats, 3 Republicans) have announced that they are not running for re-election to their current seats in Congress. According to Forbes, 9 congresswomen had announced their retirements from Congress with **no intention** of running for other public offices.

The U.S. is very likely to have fewer women in office next year than in previous years – reversing all of the important progress we’ve made since 2018 – unless we do something to stop this trend.**

body:
All Republicans, and all voters and citizens, can join us in for our FREE community town halls across the state.

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

subject: Is banning TikTok a good idea?
body:
We want to hear from you.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81201162/461692204/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzNmZTMwNWQtNGZlNS1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=AJJTEKx6HH7KMVmYC-RjnqhpiWYj7Img9orjmB0qs1c=&emci=69fe305d-4fe5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=73fe305d-4fe5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Last week, Congress passed a bill to ban TikTok over national security concerns. Joe Biden has already pledged to sign the bill if it makes it to his desk, but first, it has to pass the Senate.
**It’s all happening very quickly, but here’s the most important question: Is banning TikTok even the right move?**
[**We’ll get into the arguments on both sides in a minute, but if you’re ready to let us know what you think, go ahead and answer our survey!**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81201163/461692205/1058483356?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzNmZTMwNWQtNGZlNS1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=AJJTEKx6HH7KMVmYC-RjnqhpiWYj7Img9orjmB0qs1c=&emci=69fe305d-4fe5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=73fe305d-4fe5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=14016711)
Okay, Peter, so why the sudden rush to ban TikTok?
**In a rare moment of bipartisanship, politicians on both sides of the aisle have compelling concerns about the app.**
**First of all, like Facebook,_X_ , and YouTube, TikTok struggles to implement content moderation. With over 170 million U.S. users on the app, misinformation is thriving.** This includes political conspiracy theories but also weird trends like drinking Borax.
**Secondly, TikTok is owned by a Chinese company with ties to the Chinese government. The company collects plenty of data on its users, and it’s unclear just how private that data is.** Many in the national security field have warned that China could weaponize TikTok in the event of a war with the United States.
**The other side's argument is that TikTok’s problems happen on all social media platforms.** For example, we know the Russian government used Facebook to inflame political division and spread pro-Trump misinformation in 2020. American social media companies are known to collect and sell user data, too.
**Organizations like the ACLU say the anti-TikTok fervor is rooted in anti-Asian sentiment,** further evidenced by last year’s hearing where Senators grilled the Singaporean TikTok CEO about his connections to China. 😬
**Finally, if TikTok is banned, online influencers will have one less (extremely powerful) way to share content.** TikTok’s extremely addictive short video format has been incredible at generating huge volumes of views. | Friends, Do you remember all of the shenanigans that took place this past June when I ran for re-election to the Virginia Senate? Below I've included the documentation and press release from May 20203, in case you missed it.
It all took place under the leadership of GOP Chair Leslie Haley. This Tuesday is our chance to replace her as Chesterfield GOP Chair with an honest, principled Constitutional patriot, Dee Dee Van Buren.
I'm asking you to get out and vote for Dee Dee Van Buren and the "Re-unify the Red" slate of candidates running for GOP executive leadership in Chesterfield.
Aren't you sick and tired of the "keep it small, keep it all" good old boy and girl GOP leadership in Chesterfield, that doesn't represent most of you who vote Republican?
Sadly, the Chesterfield GOP leadership has become an exclusive bunch of elitists who put their finger on the scale for RINO candidates elected and actively work against MAGA and true conservative candidates. This has to stop.
We need a chair who has a history of strong support for President Donald J Trump and will give it everything they have to ensure he is elected this coming November.
That won't happen under current leadership.
Please tell all of your friends who live in Chesterfield to get out and vote tomorrow, Tuesday, March 19. Notice the current establishment GOP has only given you 2 hours to vote in one location. That's by design.
They don't want you to vote. They want to make it inconvenient for you to vote, so that you won't and they can stay in power and control who can run for office.
We need to replace them. And now is our chance.
We need fresh new leadership in the Chesterfield GOP, which is why I encourage all conservatives and Republicans living in Chesterfield to get out and vote for the: "RE-UNIFY THE RED" slate of candidates this coming Tuesday, March 19 between the hours of 5:30pm and 7:30pm at Swift Creek Middle School. It will only take a few minutes to vote and you don't need to stay.
Rumor is that the establishment GOP old guard is going to get their people out early so that there is a long line and you won't stay to vote.
So get there early. And be determined to vote, no matter what they try to pull.
You don't need to be a member of the Chesterfield GOP to vote. Tell every Republican you know who lives in Chesterfield to get out and vote for the Re-unify the Red slate.
I am confident that Dee Dee Van Buren and the "Re-unify the Red" slate will bring all Republicans together, work hard to elect Donald J Trump this November, and will actively work to grow the current membership of the Chesterfield GOP, so that we can ensure Chesterfield County stays "red."
Be determined to vote tomorrow and call everyone you know who lives in Chesterfield to turn out and vote so that we can make the Chesterfield GOP great again.

Documented Appearance of Election Collusion Between Chesterfield GOP Chair Leslie Haley and Sturtevant Campaign

Chesterfield GOP Chair Only Invites Sturtevant Campaign to Certify
Early Voting Equipment Prior to the Election

CHESTERFIELD, VA- Senator Amanda Chase, Chairwoman of the National Election Integrity Caucus and Incumbent Senator seeking the Republican nomination for Senate District 12 in a Republican Primary, requested and now has received documentation from the Chesterfield Country Registrar's Office to confirm suspicions of collusion between the current GOP Chair and the Sturtevant campaign.

The Chesterfield County Registrar's office has confirmed through documentation that Chesterfield GOP Chair and attorney Leslie Haley did indeed authorize Lauren Fulcher, the Campaign Manager of the Sturtevant campaign to be the sole campaign representative representing the Chesterfield GOP to witness the certification of early voting machines in Chesterfield County. No other campaigns were invited. At first she submitted the name "Lauren Fuller" but when pressed by the Chesterfield Registrar's office correctly admitted it was indeed "Lauren Fulcher."

The Chesterfield GOP Chair Leslie Haley was asked by the Chesterfield Registrar's office to provide one name to serve as the Republican representative witnessing the certification process of the early voting election equipment. She chose Lauren Fulcher, the Campaign Manager and largest donor for the Glenn Sturtevant campaign, instead of a neutral observer, which is a complete conflict of interest and the appearance of clear and convincing documentation that the Chesterfield GOP Chair is colluding and coordinating with the Sturtevant campaign to ensure victory in the Republican Primary, in which early voting began on Friday, May 5.
"This documentation appears to confirm what our team has suspected all along, collusion between the Sturtevant campaign and the Chesterfield GOP Chair to influence the SD12 race in favor of Sturtevant. It appears we have caught them red handed and have now have the documentation to support what appears to be an underhanded effort in favor of Sturtevant," stated Senator Chase.
"At a time when voter confidence in our election process is at an all-time low, we should be working diligently to restore that confidence of voters by ensuring all processes are transparent, fair and above reproach. All campaigns should have been invited to view the certification of the voting equipment, not just one. If only one representative could have been chosen, they should have been a neutral party member, not the campaign manager of one particular campaign."
"I am deeply disturbed by this egregious and obvious conflict of interest by Chairwoman Leslie Haley who we know has already endorsed Glen Sturtevant and demand her resignation immediately. It is clear she is not neutral and appears she is actively working to help Sturtevant. Leslie Haley and Glen Sturtevant are both attorneys and know better. They are without excuse."
"This is an arrogantly blatant conflict of interest and a complete failure in judgment on the part of both the party chair and the Sturtevant campaign, creating at the vey least an appearance of collusion between the Chesterfield GOP Chair and the Sturtevant campaign. Chesterfield County Chairwoman Leslie Haley needs to step down immediately," stated Senator Chase.
"Clearly this is a case of the fox guarding the hen house. I'm deeply disturbed and outraged that the Sturtevant campaign who falsely professes to be a champion for election integrity, has engaged in compromising and unacceptable behavior that further undermines the confidence of voters in a fair, transparent and uncompromised election."
Please see the documentation below submitted to Senator Chase by the Chesterfield Registrar's office and made available on the Virginia Access Project.

subject: These questions are at the core of what it means to be human
body:
I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cb427f1699594b119c99f8d1cc141534&_e=NNosRgbxFmyf9yyv2wfWNH6wD_z3NWs-GbPepDPpILl_EasU_Y7PSJa8WHprqRsGGQjphbUgi_yvGwhvlCJKvZ-AhFSkHPw-1ZvOgK-4wSPCDTapZC3yiAFKjueYRIc4ISA1wCcGAvYbdK9tfrRwaIgqPgayZxWKo9DcxphHCnYUdOUCseJcOG6VEYo_85Vez31_eO0OB0Dpbx8aHbk0pv-OYVI-RrbHokcVMM_OVqXlwkCyDOTJiyOlZAM--B4ombX2pCGB5sHJJwxk9-hDa8vTSyKAkZmkcIh7OXe2npYzqOBrNLk9HG6z8L6g1fEsf--WsYFTSEkX8_J9P0cyijKnY9W77FVxo1a_Alsv-mmvSE3toy_c6XM0eBH4IEhTv0SNAoftYvqzCLFNsWe-aPebyM0RhSgskD2zb2BNHTg%3D)

| |
Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "_Does God exist? Can we know God?_ " with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. [ ](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cb427f1699594b119c99f8d1cc141534&_e=NNosRgbxFmyf9yyv2wfWNH6wD_z3NWs-GbPepDPpILl_EasU_Y7PSJa8WHprqRsGGQjphbUgi_yvGwhvlCJKvZ-AhFSkHPw-1ZvOgK-4wSPCDTapZC3yiAFKjueYRIc4ISA1wCcGAvYbdK9tfrRwaIgqPgayZxWKo9DcxphHCnYUdOUCseJcOG6VEYo_85Vez31_eO0OB0Dpbx8aHbk0pv-OYVI-RrbHokcVMM_OVqXlwkCyDOTJiyOlZAM--B4ombX2pCGB5sHJJwxk9-hDaxN_p68wmdCKAwAft04sGzHGiBFa357WUtfNe0YyfbG4hv8Vieple96ATDjtGnOZeiuV7ua6K2641To-EcSzTEArjFzf_qrlYeWS6rDNPWo2EC2nzdrr44uyIoBpplTd73WRyxV0Bls6WTqHxdsxfO8%3D)
Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cb427f1699594b119c99f8d1cc141534&_e=NNosRgbxFmyf9yyv2wfWNH6wD_z3NWs-GbPepDPpILl_EasU_Y7PSJa8WHprqRsGGQjphbUgi_yvGwhvlCJKvZ-AhFSkHPw-1ZvOgK-4wSPCDTapZC3yiAFKjueYRIc4ISA1wCcGAvYbdK9tfrRwaIgqPgayZxWKo9DcxphHCnYUdOUCseJcOG6VEYo_85Vez31_eO0OB0Dpbx8aHbk0pv-OYVI-RrbHokcVMM_OVqXlwkCyDOTJiyOlZAM--B4ombX2pCGB5sHJJwxk9-hDa_GrhxCmI2PQ3aPSao_Be0vnraBaJhDSbbLzS8GtyeVqgIckelRJJGaueZaGdrpHF99HMWn8ykHBjoCbFlmfqC2odmfApnpzTasUAQmnWFO9KebjhF1RNpXCj1W5fJpLBj-oCp0nEQPY1Dk0b8eQ828%3D) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

More than 2,000 people have already requested theirs, so make sure to get your set before they are all gone.

Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link: **[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cb427f1699594b119c99f8d1cc141534&_e=NNosRgbxFmyf9yyv2wfWNH6wD_z3NWs-GbPepDPpILl_EasU_Y7PSJa8WHprqRsGGQjphbUgi_yvGwhvlCJKvZ-AhFSkHPw-1ZvOgK-4wSPCDTapZC3yiAFKjueYRIc4ISA1wCcGAvYbdK9tfrRwaIgqPgayZxWKo9DcxphHCnYUdOUCseJcOG6VEYo_85Vez31_eO0OB0Dpbx8aHbk0pv-OYVI-RrbHokcVMM_OVqXlwkCyDOTJiyOlZAM--B4ombX2pCGB5sHJJwxk9-hDax2iUGxpzeVY9f3FlH8S032ozLV5gCnYY6Pik_aRA39L91lfjYz2rLPDj1iADxFqLAS5zbBIzCwyAZBQZVua7AzASRJLoThhk-LGe_eLP52TDQ1S4k5qZUWf1Q5xwnZNez4rIfvbklIE3t99_X31DEg%3D)**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Dear Friend, Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "Does God exist? Can we know God? " with my students. These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America. I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me. More than 2,000 people have already requested theirs, so make sure to get your set before they are all gone. ---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8eb5a495792c4677be5e1792769858f1&_e=A7P8-u2Uh6rO-A2AH4KoU4mFx5LJBs_SRmyUk-ryBydgZlbOmc3prCCtWeO9sRXTF64JK9tkDnW0ll5OBPMUlURsO5H4Uj9Stu2J5le1g3xaT4vfz7CjipRx0XGJC3YwiXpxmhOWpSPHgBthxIFUqP-J7tLJj6grAEYxCPPuFutmEdMLjM6pI5ySJzlIRCEUhxVDMmiGaFuIrybjeexQRlDdXNHZh3kw2z8d2pngodSKJf-IQSaaQq3oIlPqxq8ndXpUpR2l2dyowRyIDjvFSQEMwz3IdVB6McbEsdBlQMeEtzdCTccFT4F6gSFajeyqSzTD9p_8p8VS_sY2renxDe_Vx5l_cLd3UuuNrKD-No7Gmqs7BVb6YDyrA5mQwihG_90fpCgS6BG8oTGgfeVM5WUjth3EfkDCLnUdL3Eyv7o%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8eb5a495792c4677be5e1792769858f1&_e=A7P8-u2Uh6rO-A2AH4KoU4mFx5LJBs_SRmyUk-ryBydgZlbOmc3prCCtWeO9sRXTF64JK9tkDnW0ll5OBPMUlURsO5H4Uj9Stu2J5le1g3xaT4vfz7CjipRx0XGJC3YwiXpxmhOWpSPHgBthxIFUqP-J7tLJj6grAEYxCPPuFutmEdMLjM6pI5ySJzlIRCEUhxVDMmiGaFuIrybjeexQRlDdXNHZh3kw2z8d2pngodSKJf-IQSaaQq3oIlPqxq8nw4hqTaa1gxaAsQCk43ZWYhQb_e6_AfEVWwxsQ_XCifk94rE_cuJFsBvRqWm5Gl3p5Ds0718fc_nvjuck745IANMLFc9vErIXJjjXulE8yVod-9H7z_3vZx2eTGNEQ9jkezL8nVaiMBKzQvBk8cyxcVGjII0l_JgO9tW72Axdgro%3D)

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

subject: What do you talk about at your kitchen table?
body:
I'd like to know!| | | The best part of my job is meeting people like you, my friend. To me, it's so important that I get out of the toxic D.C. echo chamber and walk and talk with ACTUAL people about what is going on in life at home.
