name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The current administration’s weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/XzrtEsEVUV7y1GFKqhLflg~~/AARclAA~/RgRn2yh2P0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UFNUX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDMxOFcDc3BjQgpl75aN-GU9TBcEUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College’s **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration’s weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. You can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/XzrtEsEVUV7y1GFKqhLflg~~/AARclAA~/RgRn2yh2P0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UFNUX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDMxOFcDc3BjQgpl75aN-GU9TBcEUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today’s ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education** , including **a required course on the Constitution**

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we’ve seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/XzrtEsEVUV7y1GFKqhLflg~~/AARclAA~/RgRn2yh2P0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UFNUX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDMxOFcDc3BjQgpl75aN-GU9TBcEUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 P.S. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, **I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today**. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice, which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/XzrtEsEVUV7y1GFKqhLflg~~/AARclAA~/RgRn2yh2P0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UFNUX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDMxOFcDc3BjQgpl75aN-GU9TBcEUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** |

These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education , including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we’ve seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. # _Shaping Appalachia of Tomorrow: Starting Small_
It’s time to start building back Democratic Power in Appalachia, that starts at the local level. Benjamin has traveled the South electing Democrats in hard to reach places and now has the opportunity to start bringing people into the fold. To unsubscribe, scroll down. To donate and chip in, click the button below.

Benjamin Woods, a small business owner and proud Roanoke Valley native, is running for Roanoke City Council to bring proven leadership to the Star City. Benjamin has traveled the country, navigating political landscapes, nonprofits, building businesses, and notably managing historic wins for African American candidates in campaigns across the south. Here's a couple things he's done in the past few years. Managed Chief Justice Cheri Beasley's historic campaign, Served as a Senior Advisor to Democratic Legislative Leaders Launched a Judicial reform initiative with Demand Justice.

President Joe Biden has laid out his vision for the future, team: Restoring _Roe v. Wade_ as the law of the land. Lowering prescription drugs. Making the wealthy pay their fair share. Building on a record economy. These are just a few of the things that he would do in a second term to build an America where _everyone_ has the opportunity to create a better life for themselves and their families. **But that future is at stake.** While President Biden supports a woman’s right to choose, Trump believes politicians should interfere in your most private health care decisions. While President Biden has fought to make affordable health care more accessible for _everyone,_ Trump wants to cut Medicare and Social Security. And while President Biden wants to build a fairer economy by making the wealthy and large corporations pay their fair share, Trump would rather slash benefits for hardworking Americans than raise taxes on his wealthy friends. We can shape the future of this country for years to come, but it won’t be easy. subject: I’m the **official** nominee against Ted Cruz

body:
I'm ready to outwork Ted Cruz to win this thing [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP19/1/72722/images/Screenshot%202024-03-15%20at%205.20.47%20PM.png] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Friend, I’m Colin Allred, and I'm the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate against Ted Cruz.
Now, the real fight begins. I'm ready to outwork, outraise, and out-organize Ted Cruz to win this thing, and with multiple polls already showing me TIED with Ted, I'm confident we can do it. But I also know Cruz is backed by wealthy mega donors who will spend whatever it takes to keep him in office.
That’s why I need you with me: Please, will you chip in $5 – or whatever you can spare – to help reach my $1 million General Election Kickoff goal?
Every dollar you can spare will power our people-powered movement through Election Day so we can defeat Ted Cruz and deliver better, stronger leadership for the people of Texas. Will you help kick our campaign off in a huge way by donating $5 or $25 or more to me and Kirsten Gillibrand right now? → [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Colin Allred and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately:
DONATE $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&express_lane=true&amount=5]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&express_lane=true&amount=25]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&express_lane=true&amount=50]
ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
I’m a fourth generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.
But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.
I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation.
Now, I’m ready for my next challenge : firing Ted Cruz and being the voice all Texans need in the Senate. We're already better off than we were in 2018, with experts calling Cruz the most vulnerable GOP Senator in the country, and two polls in a row showing us tied. I'm not saying it will be easy, but with you on my grassroots team, I know we can get it done, friend.
That’s why I’m asking you to chip in right now to become a General Election Founding Donor and help reach our ambitious $1 million goal. We need an unprecedented grassroots movement to unseat Ted Cruz, and I’m counting on you to be a part of it. Please, rush $5, $25 or whatever you can spare, to help me and Kirsten Gillibrand win in Texas, defeat Ted Cruz, and give Texans the leadership we deserve. → [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_colinallred?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]

Thank you so much for being a part of my team. Your support has gotten me this far, and it's why I know we can win.
Let's do this,
Colin

body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0f6ed897ed6540a493d098bbab7d4c28&_e=6BiE6_xaBvf8SizRxP6UQ4RLpxRaw2jcsbipvUz7FDq0MCYewpb2_vEnri8eVDPwLoT-pVW4P7Ff8DXeBDC0THsQf87QC_Qm6dMWNsdVvgLZzd6msmvoLoZQO6dZp8ZzqJMjnIxtVFcSCnNjsIumuiCxJ0RnrlwJ7p6-R4FKkp5BvqyLqH3kLZ_W7UoQ3kLJKVzERDYWZWek2vIGU2suL9w8zwY1ia4hPXLkX6D7sP6LaGDtd54N4YIXVloTtEBz6Sjngf_3bhZ4IDZ-KuNcAJkGj0etN6eBSs6TdQTodG2XsBra8mP4mBqBwQbS2Cq6ubZKmuI21nb3fHdskgU4rHYnhUAPSRENWP4C4REf9RuisutyXQJHooADk-oRQ18Csr6P5FoTV4DZcKLOsEqOow%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. You can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0f6ed897ed6540a493d098bbab7d4c28&_e=6BiE6_xaBvf8SizRxP6UQ4RLpxRaw2jcsbipvUz7FDq0MCYewpb2_vEnri8eVDPwLoT-pVW4P7Ff8DXeBDC0THsQf87QC_Qm6dMWNsdVvgLZzd6msmvoLoZQO6dZp8ZzqJMjnIxtVFcSCnNjsIumuiCxJ0RnrlwJ7p6-R4FKkp5BvqyLqH3kLZ_W7UoQ3kLJKVzERDYWZWek2vIGU2suL9w8zwY1ia4hPXLkX6D7sP6LaGDtd54N4YIXVloTtEBzGwJuOXmmiaPY8GhjxuRCqH04fJyvjPI0orL8TfLaUIGDd9CZeIZrJRB5s8Ql17EYZDaUHI5SqfRHv9CKY_gncd3HSz1nMkE-spdEaeP96EKjK2HmNYDdyyT4TZE3fFh3L1cTWkKpKDL66s-L29aUSA%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education** , including **a required course on the Constitution**
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0f6ed897ed6540a493d098bbab7d4c28&_e=6BiE6_xaBvf8SizRxP6UQ4RLpxRaw2jcsbipvUz7FDq0MCYewpb2_vEnri8eVDPwLoT-pVW4P7Ff8DXeBDC0THsQf87QC_Qm6dMWNsdVvgLZzd6msmvoLoZQO6dZp8ZzqJMjnIxtVFcSCnNjsIumuiCxJ0RnrlwJ7p6-R4FKkp5BvqyLqH3kLZ_W7UoQ3kLJKVzERDYWZWek2vIGU2suL9w8zwY1ia4hPXLkX6D7sP6LaGDtd54N4YIXVloTtEBzGCzRyR-L-TsL3fahtdyLgNQE-A6qpyWyhYR5ch2oc0Y29QCv3cgO4lWHzS19oEExRKqOTecWSkAxgqpH8HQBxKUjenvmq8PJC9J0NWdhWptMOEJlbAFyq6tGCuMnhoq0ogDPlxATsadnIdyDvSwU3g%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 P.S. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, **I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today**. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice, which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0f6ed897ed6540a493d098bbab7d4c28&_e=6BiE6_xaBvf8SizRxP6UQ4RLpxRaw2jcsbipvUz7FDq0MCYewpb2_vEnri8eVDPwLoT-pVW4P7Ff8DXeBDC0THsQf87QC_Qm6dMWNsdVvgLZzd6msmvoLoZQO6dZp8ZzqJMjnIxtVFcSCnNjsIumuiCxJ0RnrlwJ7p6-R4FKkp5BvqyLqH3kLZ_W7UoQ3kLJKVzERDYWZWek2vIGU2suL9w8zwY1ia4hPXLkX6D7sP6LaGDtd54N4YIXVloTtEBzcyT5mU-3yZgBNE-dffScrE5WT7tU1wQsRTe0Awb1lxsKEm_GWvXNDUu7N5YE3C7gMwzKSjwxFT1dVqVH6XmpjC3NjBmNyRwT9Je3wK-uF3_biZMpxU_mq23zVYVBvm1_sqULh7r9bXPBi5fd5If_Uw%3D%3D)** |

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

It’s been one week since Justice Democrats and more than 20 other
progressive organizations united to launch the Reject AIPAC coalition, and
the outpouring of support has been incredible.

Since we announced our joint effort to stop this right-wing mega
donor-funded lobby group’s harmful influence on our democracy and foreign
policy, nearly 30,000 people have signed on to our petition to reject
AIPAC from the Democratic Party.

We’ve also started building the financial resources needed to counteract
AIPAC’s $100 million war chest with a seven-figure ad campaign of our own
to defend the progressive incumbents they’re attempting to unseat in 2024.
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240318.V9kSZy&refcode=em20240318-33866&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=33866%2E1203867%2ESGzEwb ]If you can contribute to our fight, please consider chipping in
$5 or more now.

But AIPAC has also been busy this past week. The group held its annual
conference in Washington, D.C. to lobby members of Congress for more bombs
and weapons for the Israeli military and bring their supporters together
to hear their strategy to oust the Squad from Congress this year. Benjamin
Netanyahu himself addressed AIPAC’s 1,600 donors through a video message.

According to documents obtained by The American Prospect, “The goal of
this year’s low-key gathering was to fire up attendees for AIPAC’s 2024
agenda, before sending them off to Capitol Hill to strong-arm Congress on
supporting Israel.”

The conference talking points further confirmed AIPAC’s alignment with
Israel’s far-right government, with messaging insisting that Israel’s
military doesn’t target innocent civilians and that “reports that people
are starving in Gaza are false.”

This dangerous, false rhetoric goes against everything we know is
happening on the ground in Gaza according to reputable sources like
journalists, healthcare workers, and international aid organizations — but
it’s what they’re telling members of Congress in order to secure more U.S.
military funding for Israel.

AIPAC is not only influencing our country’s foreign policy and enabling
genocide in Gaza — they’re threatening our democracy here at home by
endorsing more than 100 Republican insurrectionists and over 200
anti-choice candidates while spending against progressive incumbents
exclusively in Democratic primaries.

That’s why it’s absolutely critical that we remove AIPAC’s influence and
dark money from the Democratic Party once and for all.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240318.V9kSZy&refcode=em20240318-33866&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=33866%2E1203867%2ESGzEwb ]Our fight to do that is just beginning. If you can afford to, please
make a grassroots contribution to fuel our efforts to Reject AIPAC during
this critical election year and beyond.

We can’t thank you enough for your support in this pivotal moment.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas

# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240318-1&t=1&akid=473%2E587540%2Ep9hrjv)
Peter, it's an exciting time at Leaders We Deserve!
**Last week, we announced our first round of 2024 endorsed candidates:**
* Sarah McBride for U.S. Congress (Delaware)
* Christine Cockley for Ohio House
* Bryce Berry for Georgia House
* Ashwin Ramaswami for Georgia Senate
* Anna Thomas for Pennsylvania House
* Anja Wookey-Huffman for Montana House

**[Can you donate $5 to elect these young, progressive changemakers?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240318-1?refcode=em20240318-1&amount=5&refcode2=473_587540_p9hrjv&akid=473%2E587540%2Ep9hrjv)**
Peter, let me explain why your support goes such a long way for our candidates.
For each of these candidates, Leaders We Deserve will be spending **_significantly_** to help get them elected. We spent more than $100,000 to help elect Nadarius Clark in Virginia last year — and we’re prepared to invest in our 2024 candidates just as heavily to give them the resources they’ll need to win on Election Day.
We work with all of our endorsed candidates on a day-to-day basis to help their campaigns run as effectively as possible. We do that by helping them create their field/GOTV plans, raise money, do call time, run ads, secure local endorsements, and more. I also personally join the campaigns in their states to help launch their canvassing events, work with volunteers, and knock doors to get out the vote.
A lot of these things can be very costly — especially running effective ad campaigns to raise money and get out the vote. That’s why it’s so crucial that Leaders We Deserve can invest in these candidates. They _NEED_ our support.

David Hogg

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81210514/461723024/1610638071?refcode=em20240318pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=576aa8a5-65e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzZhYThhNS02NWU1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8bxrDfskV7uFDF4kVocLM8U3acvrk1gX00ce0rs-q4I=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponents want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat and replacing her in Congress.**
[**Please, if you’re able to, will you consider chipping in to my campaign today to help me win this critical House seat and replace Lauren Boebert in Congress? Our race was the closest in the country, but I’m not taking money from corporate PACs. I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81210515/461723025/1610638071?refcode=em20240318pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=576aa8a5-65e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzZhYThhNS02NWU1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8bxrDfskV7uFDF4kVocLM8U3acvrk1gX00ce0rs-q4I=)

We saw some pretty scary poll numbers come out this month showing that Donald Trump could very well win this November. And I’ll be honest with you, that scares me. After Donald Trump incited an insurrection, attacked our democracy, destroyed our credibility on the world stage, and pushed an extreme agenda that hurt working families, it seems almost unbelievable that he could win again. I’m championing some key bills to take back our democracy from the forces corrupting it.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81211441/461726096/150430950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDI2MzIxYy02OGU1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UQ75iLWQMZPaEuEr83NzEGy52kICzMUSszFSElq5GAE=&emci=aed9a0b0-59e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=e426321c-68e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=7731215)

| | My colleagues and I are elected to work for "We the People," but with right-wing billionaires corrupting the Supreme Court, members of Congress trading stocks giving the appearance of conflicts of interest, and corporate interests funneling millions in dark money into Super PACs to manipulate our elections, the people's voice is being drowned out. We need to end these practices now, and that's why I'm championing some key bills to take back our democracy from the forces corrupting it. **First, the DISCLOSE Act** would end the corrupting influence of dark money, shine a bright light of transparency on political spending, and make government more accountable to voters. Dark money allows donors with special interests to easily hide their identities, making it impossible for Americans to know who is behind the massive flow of money into our elections and what motivates them. There's no place in our democratic republic for hidden expenditures by untraceable special interests. It's long past time for Congress to pass this bill and stop billionaires with right-wing agendas from secretly buying our elections. **Second, the ETHICS Act** is new, comprehensive legislation that would prohibit members of Congress, their spouses, and dependent children from using their positions for personal financial gain by owning or trading securities, commodities, or futures. We are elected to serve the public, and people need to know their representatives are working for them and not their stock portfolios. **Third, the SCERT Act** would create real ethical guardrails for the Supreme Court. Headline after headline makes it clear that the Court needs to adhere to the highest standards of ethics and transparency. The Supreme Court hands down life-altering decisions on everything from our climate to our right to vote. We need an _enforceable, transparent_ code of ethics for SCOTUS justices so the public can trust that those decisions are made without undue influence. I know you're with me on the need to clean up our government and restore trust in Washington, D.C. Let's get these bills passed to make sure we have a government of, by, and for the people. clean_body: I’m championing some key bills to take back our democracy from the forces corrupting it. | | | | My colleagues and I are elected to work for "We the People," but with right-wing billionaires corrupting the Supreme Court, members of Congress trading stocks giving the appearance of conflicts of interest, and corporate interests funneling millions in dark money into Super PACs to manipulate our elections, the people's voice is being drowned out. We need to end these practices now, and that's why I'm championing some key bills to take back our democracy from the forces corrupting it. First, the DISCLOSE Act would end the corrupting influence of dark money, shine a bright light of transparency on political spending, and make government more accountable to voters. Dark money allows donors with special interests to easily hide their identities, making it impossible for Americans to know who is behind the massive flow of money into our elections and what motivates them. There's no place in our democratic republic for hidden expenditures by untraceable special interests. It's long past time for Congress to pass this bill and stop billionaires with right-wing agendas from secretly buying our elections. Second, the ETHICS Act is new, comprehensive legislation that would prohibit members of Congress, their spouses, and dependent children from using their positions for personal financial gain by owning or trading securities, commodities, or futures. We are elected to serve the public, and people need to know their representatives are working for them and not their stock portfolios. Third, the SCERT Act would create real ethical guardrails for the Supreme Court. Headline after headline makes it clear that the Court needs to adhere to the highest standards of ethics and transparency. The Supreme Court hands down life-altering decisions on everything from our climate to our right to vote. We need an enforceable, transparent code of ethics for SCOTUS justices so the public can trust that those decisions are made without undue influence. I know you're with me on the need to clean up our government and restore trust in Washington, D.C. Let's get these bills passed to make sure we have a government of, by, and for the people. Onward! Remember? ► Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember? ► Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember?? body:
We're talking about candidates

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_remind&n=1)
---
Monday, March 18, 2024 | Peter --
### **March Statewide Call**
Please join us Tonight, March 18th at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide Call. We're discussing candidates this month. As a growing party, nothing will define us in people's minds like the candidates we work with. The Forward Party recently embarked on the creation of a new National Candidate Pledge. What does that pledge cover and what does it mean when a candidate says they want to work with us? What do we mean when we say we're looking for candidates? And when can you learn more about the candidates running for office this year? Let's talk about it together. [](https://home.forwardparty.com/pa_fwd_march_statewide_meeting_20240318?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_remind&n=2)
* * *
#### **Would you make a good candidate?**
There's also an important deadline coming for anyone thinking of running for office this year as an independent or 3rd party candidate. You have a few days to change your voter registration to make yourself eligible. We want candidates to run against uncontested state house members. To see if your house race is uncontested, use these 2 links. 1\. [Click here to Find your district.](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=r7-yZpJYUvZfHwJd04CgS_0aZ5ilYcD1nBiXPZBiJvN6NZTxeDeCyYMLc2p0LwfqihJp9FSPm9A8cFQSGtkomcofjz99NiICquJ4si4sXYI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_remind&n=3) 2\. [Click here to look up the candidates in each district.](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=N-ZescOAqg88fULNXku0buO7wvHMzu5LaEqbsXcrIuc4EQAedjh2QgfdpHGzn-5-um88OabinO6K_Iyq7MNmcWgI8gV7uRGri1cJgizGFBU&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_remind&n=4) If there are only candidates from one party listed, your district will not have a choice this November. We'd love to talk to you about giving them one. Just reply to this email.
* * *
#### **Candidate Launch Event**
We're of course also talking about our candidate Launch events on 3/26. over 90% of the people getting this invite will be within 50 miles of a major event that day so we'd love it if you'd come on out and show your support. [](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_pa_candidate_launch?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_remind&n=5) We at the Pennsylvania Forward Party are proud to introduce **two very exciting people**. They will represent the Pennsylvania Forward this year as **candidates for statewide office**. You'll hear a lot more about these candidates from us, Forward National, and hopefully, from your local sources of Pennsylvania news over the next few months. Help us get these candidates off to the best possible start by **attending one or more of the launch events on Tuesday, March 26 th, to meet them in person.** These announcements are also a great moment for the National Forward Party. Pennsylvania is one of the key states with opportunities to put Forwardists in office. We'll be joined by **big-name guests from National Forward Leadership and Partnered office holders**. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_pa_candidate_launch?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_remind&n=6 "Launch Information") [Launch Information](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_pa_candidate_launch?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_remind&n=6)
---
The March 26th **Launch Forward Day** will include **3 separate events**. The two morning events will be in **Pittsburgh at 9:30 am** and in **Philadelphia at 10 am**. Attendees from these two announcements will then journey to **Harrisburg at 2:30 pm** for a joint candidate announcement. We encourage everyone to join us at their local Candidate Announcement in the morning and join us in Harrisburg in the afternoon (if able)!
Please RSVP for an event so we can keep you up to date on details as we can release them by clicking on the links below.
* #### [Pittsburgh, 9:30 am](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_launch_pittsburgh?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_remind&n=7)
* #### [Philadelphia, 10 am](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_launch_philadelphia?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_remind&n=8)
* #### [Harrisburg, 2:30 pm](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_launch_harrisburg?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_remind&n=9)

name: Rashida Tlaib
subject: Re: I created the Rooted in Community PAC to train and support grassroots activists, candidates, and groups that are focused on meeting their communities’ needs.
body:
Building a future where everyone feels safe and has their needs met. | | |
---
Friend, The American people are demanding their representatives stop investing in war and instead invest in our communities. That’s why I’m in office: to fight for my communities’ needs as a public servant. In partnership with local groups, I just secured over $17 million in federal funding for 15 community projects in my district. These investments will help get the lead out of our pipes, provide affordable housing and home repairs, support storm recovery and decrease pollution, help build new centers for seniors and workforce development, and more. Our communities desperately need such investments and deserve elected officials who truly represent them. That’s why I created the Rooted in Community PAC, to train and support grassroots activists, candidates, and groups that are helping their communities thrive. During the 2022 mid-term election, we ran free trainings for community organizers and candidates and we donated more than $128,000 to progressive candidates and organizations. This critical election year when even more is at stake, we’re supporting movement groups and candidates in my home state of Michigan and across the country. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81213154/461731112/-1514006159?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOTRmNGEwMS02ZGU1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gyMyevzYjWl0FIVW4KmI1IvDeSoh4RYD_0BYlw5A1z0=) My name is Briana Sewell. I’m running to become the first Black woman to represent Virginia’s 7th District in Congress. body:
Missouri is on the frontlines of the fight for power in our country.
#
Peter,
I’m running for U.S. Senate because I want everyday Missourians to call the shots in our country — not giant corporations or the cowards like Josh Hawley they’ve bought off in Washington. **This email is long, but I hope you’ll take some time to read it:**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44630?refcode=em20240318-5077&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5077%2E614464%2EtFHLTO)**
**When I came home between deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan, it was clear to me that Missouri is on the frontlines of the fight for power in our country.**
While communities like mine all across our state were stripped for parts, corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley attacked workers with anti-union schemes like “Right-to-Work” and fought to block wage increases for Missouri families — all to enrich multinational corporations and mega-donors who bankroll their campaigns and their careers.
They helped Wall Street financiers sell off our farmland to billionaires in China and Brazil — devastating rural communities and contributing to the closure of 90% of Missouri hog producers in a single generation.
One of Missouri’s oldest and largest employers, Anheuser-Busch, was sold to a Belgian conglomerate — costing Missouri more than a thousand jobs.
Missouri-based Monsanto, one of the world’s most important agrochemical and biotechnology companies, was sold to Germany — eliminating even more jobs.
And as dozens more headquarters have been taken out of state, politicians in power like Josh Hawley were happy to sit back and watch it happen.
**Manufacturing, agriculture, production — they’re shipping it all away to foreign oligarchs who don’t care about working people in our state.** And while our communities were getting gutted, these same politicians voted time and time again to spend trillions of dollars and thousands of lives on overseas wars that got their Big Oil friends rich.
These politicians have spent decades sparking phony culture wars to distract and divide our families. They’ve become so obsessed with controlling our lives, they made Missouri the first state in the nation to ban abortion — without exceptions for victims of rape or incest.
**Our state deserves a Senator who will stand up and fight for it — and I’m ready to serve.[So if you’re ready to elect a real warrior for working people to Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, will you please rush a donation of any amount toward my grassroots campaign today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44630?refcode=em20240318-5077&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5077%2E614464%2EtFHLTO)**

---
We aren’t fighting the corporate status quo just to make a point, either. **This is a race we really can win.**
Our values have won at the ballot box in Missouri for referendums that go beyond what’s happening nowadays in Washington, or even what political elites in Jefferson City are willing to allow.
For the last three election cycles, Missouri voters have side-stepped our politicians by voting to increase the minimum wage well above the federal level, expand health care, repeal an anti-worker “Right-to-Work” scheme, legalize weed, and enact more protections against political corruption with wide margins.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44630?refcode=em20240318-5077&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=5077%2E614464%2EtFHLTO)
**So now, we’re building a record-breaking, people-powered movement to defeat Josh Hawley and take this Senate seat back for working Missourians.**
Together, we’re going to stop printing money for Wall Street and start funding our schools enough to get Missouri out of last place for starting teacher pay.
We’re going to abolish corporate PACs and demand a government that safeguards our democracy and holds corrupt politicians accountable.
We’re going to take back Missouri farmland for Missouri farmers and start manufacturing essential drugs right here in America.
We’re going to build an economy that puts American workers and small businesses in charge, not giant corporations and foreign oligarchs — an economy that invests in putting America first in the next generation of energy, semiconductors, and supply chain independence.
We’re going to put an end to pointless, trillion-dollar wars and invest in a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a historic investment in our workers and communities to rebuild our forgotten towns and cities, and to finally start making stuff in America again.
And we’re going to finally put everyday Missourians in charge of their own neighborhoods, workplaces, and bodies.

clean_body: Missouri is on the frontlines of the fight for power in our country. Peter, I’m running for U.S. Senate because I want everyday Missourians to call the shots in our country — not giant corporations or the cowards like Josh Hawley they’ve bought off in Washington. This email is long, but I hope you’ll take some time to read it: When I came home between deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan, it was clear to me that Missouri is on the frontlines of the fight for power in our country. While communities like mine all across our state were stripped for parts, corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley attacked workers with anti-union schemes like “Right-to-Work” and fought to block wage increases for Missouri families — all to enrich multinational corporations and mega-donors who bankroll their campaigns and their careers. They helped Wall Street financiers sell off our farmland to billionaires in China and Brazil — devastating rural communities and contributing to the closure of 90% of Missouri hog producers in a single generation. One of Missouri’s oldest and largest employers, Anheuser-Busch, was sold to a Belgian conglomerate — costing Missouri more than a thousand jobs. Missouri-based Monsanto, one of the world’s most important agrochemical and biotechnology companies, was sold to Germany — eliminating even more jobs. And as dozens more headquarters have been taken out of state, politicians in power like Josh Hawley were happy to sit back and watch it happen. Manufacturing, agriculture, production — they’re shipping it all away to foreign oligarchs who don’t care about working people in our state. And while our communities were getting gutted, these same politicians voted time and time again to spend trillions of dollars and thousands of lives on overseas wars that got their Big Oil friends rich. These politicians have spent decades sparking phony culture wars to distract and divide our families. They’ve become so obsessed with controlling our lives, they made Missouri the first state in the nation to ban abortion — without exceptions for victims of rape or incest. Our state deserves a Senator who will stand up and fight for it — and I’m ready to serve. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: We aren’t fighting the corporate status quo just to make a point, either. This is a race we really can win. Our values have won at the ballot box in Missouri for referendums that go beyond what’s happening nowadays in Washington, or even what political elites in Jefferson City are willing to allow. For the last three election cycles, Missouri voters have side-stepped our politicians by voting to increase the minimum wage well above the federal level, expand health care, repeal an anti-worker “Right-to-Work” scheme, legalize weed, and enact more protections against political corruption with wide margins. So now, we’re building a record-breaking, people-powered movement to defeat Josh Hawley and take this Senate seat back for working Missourians. Together, we’re going to stop printing money for Wall Street and start funding our schools enough to get Missouri out of last place for starting teacher pay. We’re going to abolish corporate PACs and demand a government that safeguards our democracy and holds corrupt politicians accountable. We’re going to take back Missouri farmland for Missouri farmers and start manufacturing essential drugs right here in America. We’re going to build an economy that puts American workers and small businesses in charge, not giant corporations and foreign oligarchs — an economy that invests in putting America first in the next generation of energy, semiconductors, and supply chain independence. We’re going to put an end to pointless, trillion-dollar wars and invest in a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a historic investment in our workers and communities to rebuild our forgotten towns and cities, and to finally start making stuff in America again. And we’re going to finally put everyday Missourians in charge of their own neighborhoods, workplaces, and bodies. It’s time to take our power back — and we can’t do it without your support. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Thank you for everything, Peter. Now let’s get moving, Lucas | | Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri

body:
|
#
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81213691/461732592/-1649600083?contactdata=0OoyKlG/0A/bakgX6B87qzcuhaW07ky4uGpnHRZHvYe6OYej3MKfBnNfOvSyQisd9lViYV+5q/rVYYYciTCzYvGsWpKB//FBzJn5QiQdxrdse4VXA3uJ4Win/A8imMjCyztQHXzFSY2pvEoDw+tI8xKhkthSkicg6Rypb7LSD10=&refcode=AU_MKH_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240318_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTRkNGRhYi02ZWU1LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mguv7Z9RgjtdsP9cdp3bs3YHPbIIcdeS-nQKGUY5L5g=&emci=b0c534e3-2de5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=914d4dab-6ee5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=23190490) Aloha Peter, Here’s something I think we can all agree on: **Voting should be easy and accessible for every American. After all, the right to vote is not a privilege,_it’s a right!_** But for too many Americans, voting is easier said than done. subject: What state has the most expensive water?
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetkte8QXv-1Ygp1zWjhxil2P48iV1nhW66bOPKauw2zjSyo&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=031824_water&n=1&v=27)
---
Dear Friend, It’s pretty shocking that the U.S. calls itself a leader of the free world and yet fails to provide the most basic service—clean water—to a considerable part of the population nationwide. And let’s be clear: it’s primarily black, brown, poor, and working-class folks who are time and time again exposed to lead, dangerous forever chemicals, or other contaminants in their water supply—if they even have access to running water. Our Representatives and Senators have been failing us election cycle after cycle. If we can send tens of billions of dollars to fight the proxy war with Russia until the last Ukrainian or aid Israel in killing innocent children in Gaza, we should be able to spend a similar amount fighting the battle for clean, affordable water here at home! As your Senator, I will fight for clean water everywhere. **[With your help, we will defeat the MAGA Republican Jim Justice, who keeps ignoring the needs of the people of West Virginia, whom we will likely face in November. Can you chip in $15 today to help us win?](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetkte8QXv-1Ygp1zWjhxil2P48NVNXHPGwMTpcO2-79tvsJ&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=031824_water&n=2&v=27)**
****

---
Two-thirds of West Virginia counties have water delivery systems that are among the worst in the country, according to the federal Environmental Protection Agency’s Safe Drinking Water Act violation records. Many residents of McDowell County, for instance, rely on wells that are vulnerable to contamination from their surroundings. An estimated two-thirds of homes there lack basic wastewater treatment, and many homeowners pipe waste straight into nearby streams. Throughout the state, forever chemicals from oil and gas drilling infiltrate water systems without oversight, posing severe health risks to consumers. In towns like Minden, health officials have discovered high rates of cancer. In the southern coalfields, dozens of communities are served by failing or distressed utilities lacking the resources to deliver safe drinking water adequately. Several communities have lived under years-long boil water advisories due to underground contamination from mining operations and more. On top of that, **West Virginians pay the highest average water bill than any other state in the nation, at about $91 per month.** In addition to stricter regulations to prevent water supply contamination, we need the federal government to step in and make the necessary investments to ensure that West Virginians and all Americans have clean water to drink. **[Help us win this election, and you’ll have a clean, safe, and affordable water champion in the U.S. Senate.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetkte8QXv-1Ygp1zWjhxil2P48iV1nhW66bOPKauw2zjSyo&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=031824_water&n=4&v=27)** Thank you, Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV) Candidate, U.S. Senate

Pennsylvania is my home, and it always will be.

It’s where I was born, where I grew up, and where Terese and I raised our family.

It’s also where I started a career in public service that has always been about fighting for Pennsylvania families.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81213982/461733648/-887798292?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-03-18_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU4OTQ3MmFjLTcwZTUtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=A1AI13NC5lW_VF_1ZI6lUhAn5orHqQVYVOi36Koa9ks=)
I chose to make Scranton my home because of the people. I enjoy that in Scranton, saying “hello” or “how’s it going?” in the grocery store checkout line always leads to an engaging conversation. Neighbors don’t just say “hello” back and go on with their day. They’re going to tell you about what they’re buying and about their family — and they’ll ask you about what you’re buying and about your family, too.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81213984/461733650/-887798292?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-03-18_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU4OTQ3MmFjLTcwZTUtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=A1AI13NC5lW_VF_1ZI6lUhAn5orHqQVYVOi36Koa9ks=)
Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m proud of the fights we’ve won together.

I’m running for re-election because there are fights we still must win together – like the fight for voting rights, women’s rights, and workers’ rights; the fight to lower costs for working families; and the fight for our children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81213986/461733652/-887798292?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-03-18_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU4OTQ3MmFjLTcwZTUtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=A1AI13NC5lW_VF_1ZI6lUhAn5orHqQVYVOi36Koa9ks=)
The reality is, this is going to be my toughest race yet. My opponent is worth hundreds of millions of dollars and will be another “yes” vote for big corporations and the ultra-wealthy like him in the Senate. **That’s why Wall Street billionaires are trying so hard to defeat me and flip this seat.**

This is going to be one of the most expensive Senate races in the Nation, and we have to be ready to fight back against millions upon millions in outside spending if we’re going to win.

clean_body: Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m proud of the fights we’ve won together. | Peter, in a moment, I’m going to share why I’m running for re-election, but first I am asking: = | = Pennsylvania is my home, and it always will be. It’s where I was born, where I grew up, and where Terese and I raised our family. It’s also where I started a career in public service that has always been about fighting for Pennsylvania families. = I chose to make Scranton my home because of the people. I enjoy that in Scranton, saying “hello” or “how’s it going?” in the grocery store checkout line always leads to an engaging conversation. Neighbors don’t just say “hello” back and go on with their day. They’re going to tell you about what they’re buying and about their family — and they’ll ask you about what you’re buying and about your family, too. = Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m proud of the fights we’ve won together. I’m running for re-election because there are fights we still must win together – like the fight for voting rights, women’s rights, and workers’ rights; the fight to lower costs for working families; and the fight for our children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities. = The reality is, this is going to be my toughest race yet. My opponent is worth hundreds of millions of dollars and will be another “yes” vote for big corporations and the ultra-wealthy like him in the Senate. That’s why Wall Street billionaires are trying so hard to defeat me and flip this seat. body:
With just 50 days until the May Primary, this past week on the campaign trail has been nothing short of eventful!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

With just 50 days until the May Primary, this past week on the campaign trail has been nothing short of eventful, marked by my first gubernatorial debate, the signing of a major bill to protect Hoosier farmland, a tour of Allen County and so much more.

I'm thrilled to be pressing pause for a moment to provide you with a glimpse into these key moments and accomplishments.

Let's hit the highlights!

** Current Carmel Debate: Sharing My Bold Vision for Indiana (https://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/elections/2024/03/12/indiana-governors-race-6-republicans-spar-in-first-debate/72901946007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

Last week, I had the opportunity to share my bold vision for Indiana at the Current Carmel Debate.

A vote for me is a vote to eliminate Indiana’s individual income tax, invest in mental health, stop China’s land grab attempts, and move Indiana to the future.

Thank you, Hoosiers, for your support and engagement.

** IN THE NEWS: Crouch: 'Axe the Tax' to leave more money in Hoosier pockets (https://www.ibj.com/articles/lt-gov-suzanne-crouch-axe-the-tax-to-leave-more-money-in-hoosier-pockets?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

Hoosiers deserve a leader who will fight for their financial freedom. As Governor, I'll implement bold, creative initiatives like "Axe the Tax."

By eliminating Indiana's individual income tax, we'll put an average of $2,000 in Hoosiers' pockets every year and attract talent, businesses, and investments to our state.

Proud to lead the charge to put Hoosiers first and unleash Indiana's full potential.
https://www.ibj.com/articles/lt-gov-suzanne-crouch-axe-the-tax-to-leave-more-money-in-hoosier-pockets?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
ARTICLE (https://www.ibj.com/articles/lt-gov-suzanne-crouch-axe-the-tax-to-leave-more-money-in-hoosier-pockets?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Protecting Hoosier Farmland: Signing HEA 1183 (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid0Z5HCAnvrWKoroS3bNyEHUfB8hC4AASmgeFvma6P7J7nJLPPXWCymhGQmjp7fn3VGl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Last week, in my role as Secretary of Agriculture, I had the immense privilege of signing HEA 1183 (https://iga.in.gov/legislative/2024/bills/house/1183/details?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , which prevents foreign adversaries from buying Indiana land near our military bases.

By signing this bill, we send a clear message: Our land is off-limits, and our security will not be threatened by foreign adversaries.

** STATEMENT: The Indiana Department of Health is not above the law (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid0Bhxr6vCPNSw9GHThgn7HqjvyHi33uz339LCnoFxbW21RHLeb4beRNJLnaNqiuDnNl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

Reporting of Terminated Pregnancy Reports shall be made available as provided by Indiana law.

It is shocking that the Indiana Department of Health now believes it can ignore existing law and refuses to continue to make those reports public.

I can assure you that when I am governor, I will make sure our pro-life laws are enforced and that my agency heads follow the laws.

** Allen County GOP Breakfast
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I had the pleasure of attending and speaking at the Allen County Republican Party's Breakfast on Saturday morning.

It was a wonderful opportunity to connect with fellow Republicans and discuss some of my bold plans for our state, including creating a cradle-to-career education system and streamlining government to work better for Hoosiers.

I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to Chairman Steven Shine for organizing this event!

** Allen County Republican Women
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Later in the afternoon, I️ went to the Allen County Republican Women's Club meeting.

It was inspiring to see so many passionate women dedicated to making a difference in our community!

https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

During the meeting, I shared my vision for Indiana, including my plan to eliminate Indiana's individual income tax through a phased approach and how, as Governor, I️ would make mental health a priority in our state.

** Northeast Indiana Right to Life Banquet
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

It was an honor to attend the Northeast Indiana Right to Life Banquet, celebrating 50 years of protecting the most vulnerable among us.

Life is sacred, and it is our duty to ensure that every voice, no matter how small, is heard and respected.

** Allen County War Memorial
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Visiting the Allen County War Memorial Museum on Saturday was a truly enriching experience.

The Coliseum is not only a hub for family entertainment, arts, and sports but also a testament to the valor and sacrifice of our brave servicemen and women. Walking through its halls, I was reminded of the profound significance of preserving our history and honoring those who have selflessly served our nation.

https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

It was a humbling reminder of the debt of gratitude we owe to our veterans and the importance of ensuring their legacy is cherished and preserved for generations to come.

** SUPPORTER SPOTLIGHT: Team Crouch at Carmel Current Debate
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=ac4082b754-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_49&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-ac4082b754-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I am incredibly grateful for the unwavering support of Team Crouch, who showed up in force at the Current Carmel Debate! We had so many dedicated members of our team filling the crowd and showing their support.

Your hard work and commitment do not go unnoticed. Your presence at the debate exemplified the strength and unity of our campaign, and I am proud to have such a passionate team standing behind me!

------------------------------------------------------------

Thank YOU for supporting my campaign.

We have by far, no contest, the strongest grassroots campaign in the race for Governor. We are leading a movement for positive change in our state and it simply would not be possible without Hoosiers like you.

As we continue to push forward, let's keep our spirits high and our determination unwavering. With your continued support, there's no limit to what we can achieve together.

Onward and upward,

clean_body: With just 50 days until the May Primary, this past week on the campaign trail has been nothing short of eventful! Friends and fellow Hoosiers, With just 50 days until the May Primary, this past week on the campaign trail has been nothing short of eventful, marked by my first gubernatorial debate, the signing of a major bill to protect Hoosier farmland, a tour of Allen County and so much more. I'm thrilled to be pressing pause for a moment to provide you with a glimpse into these key moments and accomplishments. Let's hit the highlights! Current Carmel Debate: Sharing My Bold Vision for Indiana () Last week, I had the opportunity to share my bold vision for Indiana at the Current Carmel Debate. A vote for me is a vote to eliminate Indiana’s individual income tax, invest in mental health, stop China’s land grab attempts, and move Indiana to the future. Thank you, Hoosiers, for your support and engagement. IN THE NEWS: Crouch: 'Axe the Tax' to leave more money in Hoosier pockets () Hoosiers deserve a leader who will fight for their financial freedom. As Governor, I'll implement bold, creative initiatives like "Axe the Tax." By eliminating Indiana's individual income tax, we'll put an average of $2,000 in Hoosiers' pockets every year and attract talent, businesses, and investments to our state. Proud to lead the charge to put Hoosiers first and unleash Indiana's full potential. ARTICLE () Protecting Hoosier Farmland: Signing HEA 1183 () Last week, in my role as Secretary of Agriculture, I had the immense privilege of signing HEA 1183 () , which prevents foreign adversaries from buying Indiana land near our military bases. By signing this bill, we send a clear message: Our land is off-limits, and our security will not be threatened by foreign adversaries. STATEMENT: The Indiana Department of Health is not above the law () Reporting of Terminated Pregnancy Reports shall be made available as provided by Indiana law. It is shocking that the Indiana Department of Health now believes it can ignore existing law and refuses to continue to make those reports public. I can assure you that when I am governor, I will make sure our pro-life laws are enforced and that my agency heads follow the laws. Allen County GOP Breakfast I had the pleasure of attending and speaking at the Allen County Republican Party's Breakfast on Saturday morning. It was a wonderful opportunity to connect with fellow Republicans and discuss some of my bold plans for our state, including creating a cradle-to-career education system and streamlining government to work better for Hoosiers. I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to Chairman Steven Shine for organizing this event! Allen County Republican Women Later in the afternoon, I️ went to the Allen County Republican Women's Club meeting. It was inspiring to see so many passionate women dedicated to making a difference in our community! During the meeting, I shared my vision for Indiana, including my plan to eliminate Indiana's individual income tax through a phased approach and how, as Governor, I️ would make mental health a priority in our state. Northeast Indiana Right to Life Banquet It was an honor to attend the Northeast Indiana Right to Life Banquet, celebrating 50 years of protecting the most vulnerable among us. Life is sacred, and it is our duty to ensure that every voice, no matter how small, is heard and respected. Allen County War Memorial Visiting the Allen County War Memorial Museum on Saturday was a truly enriching experience. The Coliseum is not only a hub for family entertainment, arts, and sports but also a testament to the valor and sacrifice of our brave servicemen and women. Walking through its halls, I was reminded of the profound significance of preserving our history and honoring those who have selflessly served our nation. It was a humbling reminder of the debt of gratitude we owe to our veterans and the importance of ensuring their legacy is cherished and preserved for generations to come. SUPPORTER SPOTLIGHT: Team Crouch at Carmel Current Debate I am incredibly grateful for the unwavering support of Team Crouch, who showed up in force at the Current Carmel Debate! We had so many dedicated members of our team filling the crowd and showing their support. Your hard work and commitment do not go unnoticed. Your presence at the debate exemplified the strength and unity of our campaign, and I am proud to have such a passionate team standing behind me! ICYMI: Endorsements () Suzanne Crouch is the only gubernatorial candidate who has been endorsed by more than 100 past and present elected officials in Indiana. A full list of those endorsements can be found here. () Last but not least... Thank YOU for supporting my campaign. We have by far, no contest, the strongest grassroots campaign in the race for Governor. We are leading a movement for positive change in our state and it simply would not be possible without Hoosiers like you. As we continue to push forward, let's keep our spirits high and our determination unwavering. With your continued support, there's no limit to what we can achieve together. Onward and upward, Let's keep the conversation going! Follow me on social to keep up with the campaign. Have questions, comments or concerns? Send me an email! clean_body: | | | Fellow American, “De Oppresso Liber” It’s the Green Beret motto, and it means “to liberate the oppressed.” As a Green Beret, you put your service to your country over EVERYTHING. If we’re going to change the way Washington works, there’s only one way to do it: with battle-tested combat veterans who understand what it’s like to put service over self. That’s why I’m proud to support fellow Green Beret, Pat Harrigan for Congress. Pat put his life on the line serving our country as a Green Beret. He knows better than most what’s at risk if we let our country fall. There are enemies in every corner of the world who want to see America fail, and we need leaders like Pat in Congress if we’re going to keep our country strong enough to take them down. Dear Peter,
I recently had the opportunity to discuss President Biden’s competency on national television.
It goes without saying, the stakes are incredibly high.
Our children's future hangs on the decisions made during those critical 3:00 AM calls. We must have confidence in a president who can rise to the occasion, who is sharp and alert – even in the dead of night – considering the weighty matters that affect our nation.
President Biden must step forward and demonstrate to the American people that he possesses the cognitive ability and mental clarity required for this demanding role, especially during what may be one of the most challenging times in recent American history.
We're facing existential challenges. We’re engaged in multiple wars and confronting dire economic calamities. The middle class is disappearing, with 57% of Americans unable to access $1,000 in an emergency. An entire generation is struggling to afford homes.
This is nothing short of a crisis. We need a president who not only recognizes these pressing issues but also is able to articulate viable solutions to the American people.
Again, our children's futures hang in the balance, and we need assurance that our president is equipped to confront these challenges head-on, even in the darkest hours of the night.
America is in desperate need of honest leadership – the kind that comes from a rigorous leader able and willing to make hard choices to lead our nation through turbulent times.
Together, we can tackle the challenges ahead and build an America full of economic promise. An America that is healthier, more free, and embraces our best qualities.
Because of your support, this is now the most successful independent campaign in history. _Can I count on you now to go the distance with me?_
[Our goal is to raise $4 million before the end of the month FEC report is due. It is absolutely attainable with 100% participation from friends like you.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-policies-video?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_comp_3_18_24_nd3&n=5)
